### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `d8a9cc59` (read-only check):
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`: `KanbanBoardProps.canDropCard?: (fromColumnId, toColumnId) => boolean` (≈L241) is a bare boolean, so no reason exists today. `isDropBlocked` (≈L1103) feeds `dropBlocked` to the lane (≈L1671 → `aria-disabled` ≈L783, `data-kanban-drop-blocked` ≈L784, `opacity-40` ≈L794). The swimlane cell (≈L1637–1644) draws the same three attributes separately.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` ≈L1822 is the board's only supplier. The gate is ONLY the object's blocking `state_machine` rule on the `groupBy` field, through `stateMachineNextValues` (`ui/packages/core/src/validation/validators/state-machine-next-values.ts`), which intersects every blocking update machine's `transitions[from]`. A required field never blocks a lane: it prompts after the drop (objectui#4254). A missing permission makes the cards not movable (`kanbanCardMove` affordance), so no lane is dimmed. The card's "transition, required field or permission" therefore reduces to the state-machine rule here; confirm it.
- Every validation rule carries a required `message` (`BASE_VALIDATION_SHAPE`, `packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts` ≈L157). It is the text the server's refusal of the same move shows.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

1. Let the gate return the reason beside the verdict, without breaking the boolean prop. For example, add an optional `dropBlockedReason?: (from, to) => string | undefined` on `KanbanBoardProps` and `KanbanBoardCore`, or a sibling helper in core that returns the blocking rule(s), not just the set.
2. In `ObjectKanban`, the reason is the `message` of the blocking rule that excludes the target. Localize it the way the record form or the server refusal renders a validation message, if such a path exists; otherwise use it as authored. If several rules block, join their messages. With no message, fall back to a new i18n key along the lines of "This move isn't allowed from {from} to {to}", added in every locale pack the plugin's other keys live in.
3. On a blocked lane (and the swimlane cell), set `title` plus `aria-describedby`, pointing at a visually hidden element that carries the reason. Set them only while blocked, so an open lane gains nothing.

Tests (beside the existing `#25933` drop-gate tests in `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/`):
- During a drag, a blocked lane exposes the rule's message through `title` and through the `aria-describedby` target.
- CONTROL: an open lane carries neither.
- CONTROL: the fallback text when the rule has no usable message, if you add a fallback.

Ablation: drop the reason attributes; the blocked-lane test goes red.
